# AGENTS.md

Pure-Bun Codex gateway: ChatCompletions <-> Responses for the Codex desktop/CLI
app, zero npm dependencies. Declared models route to chat (OpenAI-compatible)
*or* Responses providers; undeclared models pass through to the signed-in
ChatGPT backend. Distributed as a compiled binary (`bun run build` ->
`codextras`); run it wherever you install it and state/, logs/,
codextras.json resolve next to it.

## Commands

    codextras start|stop|status       daemonize via pidfile
    codextras catalog                 declared-models catalog
    codextras catalog-merged          capture native catalog + write state/merged-models.json
    codextras dry-run [alias]         render future config.toml without writing
    codextras apply [alias]           backup + switch ~/.codex/config.toml to codextras
    codextras restore                 restore the pre-codextras config.toml
    bun run build                     compile the binary (src/cli.mjs)
    bun test                          unit tests (stop the gateway first: port conflict)
    ./smoke/verify-after-switch.sh    live checks (needs gateway running + real upstream key)

## Architecture

    src/server.mjs          Bun.serve: /v1/responses, /v1/responses/compact, /v1/models, WS refused with 426
    src/adapter.mjs         chat + Responses builders (thinking envelope, efforts, include, store, stream_options)
    src/convert/request.mjs Responses items -> chat messages (reasoning, tools, images, compaction) + flattenToolsForResponses
    src/convert/tools.mjs   custom/freeform tool bridge (exec etc.)
    src/convert/stream.mjs  chat SSE -> Responses SSE lifecycle (responses upstream is proxied verbatim)
    src/convert/json.mjs    non-streaming chat -> Responses
    src/catalog.mjs         catalog entry generation + native merge + visibility overrides (supports_reasoning_summaries toggleable)
    src/codex-config.mjs    config.toml managed-block rendering
    src/compaction.mjs      compaction v1/v2 with kcr1: summary envelope (chat or responses per provider)

## Onboarding: configure a model

Edit `codextras.json`. Providers are OpenAI-compatible chat **or Responses**
endpoints; `provider.type` (or `wireApi`/`api`) selects the wire format.
`type: "openai-chat"` (default) → `/chat/completions` with Chat↔Responses
bridging (needed for DeepSeek); `type: "openai-responses"` →
`/responses` with verbatim Responses passthrough (needed for Muse Spark,
preserves `reasoning.encrypted_content` + true multimodal). All three
dimensions are toggleable per-model: vision via `inputModalities` +
`imagePassthrough`, wire format via `provider.type` *or* `model.wireApi`/`model.api`,
and reasoning via `reasoningInjection`/`disableThoughtHack` +
`reasoningSummary`/`supportsReasoningSummaries`. Quirks carry per-provider
differences as data (thinking envelope, effort aliases, stream_options,
`include`). Relative `apiKeyFile` paths resolve against the repo root.

Example (opencode-go provider + DeepSeek V4 Flash):

```json
{
  "gateway": { "port": 4200, "pathPrefix": "/_codextras" },
  "providers": [
    {
      "id": "opencode-go",
      "type": "openai-chat",
      "baseUrl": "https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1",
      "apiKeyEnv": ["OPENCODE_API_KEY", "OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY"],
      "apiKeyFile": "./state/opencode-go-api-key.secret",
      "quirks": {
        "thinking": { "type": "enabled" },
        "efforts": { "low": "low", "high": "high", "max": "max" },
        "streamOptions": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "models": [
    {
      "alias": "deepseek-flash",
      "displayName": "V4 Flash",
      "provider": "opencode-go",
      "upstreamModel": "deepseek-v4-flash",
      "contextWindow": 1048576,
      "autoCompact": 900000,
      "efforts": ["low", "high", "max"],
      "defaultEffort": "high",
      "inputModalities": ["text", "image"],
      "imagePassthrough": false
    }
  ]
}
```

Then `codextras apply <alias>` and restart the Codex app (it caches the
catalog). `catalogOverrides` can force native-model visibility (e.g.
`{"gpt-5.2": {"visibility": "hide"}}`).

Dual-provider example (DeepSeek on chat + Muse Spark on Responses, same key):

```json
{
  "providers": [
    { "id": "opencode-go-chat", "type": "openai-chat", "baseUrl": "https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1", "apiKeyEnv": ["OPENCODE_API_KEY"], "quirks": { "thinking": { "type": "enabled" }, "efforts": { "low": "low", "high": "high", "max": "max" } } },
    { "id": "opencode-go-responses", "type": "openai-responses", "baseUrl": "https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1", "apiKeyEnv": ["OPENCODE_API_KEY"], "quirks": { "efforts": { "minimal": "minimal", "low": "low", "medium": "medium", "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh" }, "include": ["reasoning.encrypted_content"], "reasoningSummary": "auto", "store": false } }
  ],
  "models": [
    { "alias": "deepseek-flash", "provider": "opencode-go-chat", "upstreamModel": "deepseek-v4-flash", "efforts": ["low","high","max"], "defaultEffort": "high", "inputModalities": ["text","image"], "imagePassthrough": false },
    { "alias": "muse-spark", "provider": "opencode-go-responses", "upstreamModel": "muse-spark-1.2", "efforts": ["minimal","low","medium","high","xhigh"], "defaultEffort": "high", "inputModalities": ["text","image"], "imagePassthrough": true, "supportsReasoningSummaries": true, "reasoningSummary": "auto" }
  ]
}
```
Alternative single-provider toggle: set `"api": "responses"` (or `wireApi`/`targetApi`) per `models[]` entry to override the provider’s wire format — same `type` field works per-model. Vision (`imagePassthrough`), wire format, and `<thought>` hack are all toggleable.

## Hard-won constraints

- The managed block in config.toml must stay at the TOP of the file: root keys
  (`openai_base_url`, `model_catalog_json`) land inside whatever table precedes
  them otherwise, and Codex silently ignores them.
- Reasoning is preserved twice for **chat** providers: `reasoning_content` on
  assistant messages (the DeepSeek API contract when tools are present) AND a
  visible `<thought>` block (the model's only real memory). Never use
  `<think>`: the upstream's reasoning parser strips that exact tag from
  assistant content. **Responses** providers (Muse Spark) do not use this
  hack — they replay `reasoning.encrypted_content` via `include` + `store:false`
  and should disable it with `reasoningInjection:"none"` / `disableThoughtHack`.
  Muse’s `summary` is empty today (encrypted only).
- Custom tools (exec) are advertised as functions with a single required
  `content` string property and returned as `custom_tool_call` items (see
  convert/tools.mjs). This mirrors the proven LiteLLM bridge; the app's tool
  router rejects plain `function_call` items for freeform tools.
- Catalog entries require `experimental_supported_tools` and should set
  `prefer_websockets: false`; Codex falls back to its built-in catalog if the
  file fails to parse.
- WebSocket upgrades get `426` on purpose: Codex falls back to HTTP streaming
  immediately. Do not add a WS endpoint.
- `state/` and `logs/` hold secrets (gateway token, provider API key, catalog
  JSONs). Never commit them.

## Verification loop

1. `codextras stop && bun test && codextras start`
2. `./smoke/verify-after-switch.sh` (health, config.toml root keys, catalog,
   real upstream turn, compaction, WS 426)
3. `codextras apply <alias>`, then the Codex app must be fully quit and
   reopened to reload the catalog.

## Conventions

Bun-only, no npm dependencies, no build step. Match the existing style (ESM,
plain functions, minimal abstraction). Add unit tests for conversion logic in
test/gateway.test.mjs; live behaviors belong in the smoke script.

333: // Plain `codex debug models` returns the effective catalog, which includes
334: // our own merged file (Codex loads it via model_catalog_json). The fake
335: // binary below reproduces that: --bundled is pristine, plain is polluted
336: // with a stale declared model. Capture must prefer --bundled so removed
337: // models never resurrect in the native cache.
338: function writeFakeCodexBin(dir, { failBundled = false } = {}) {
339:   const fakeBin = path.join(dir, "codex");
340:   writeFileSync(
341:     fakeBin,
342:     `#!/usr/bin/env bun
343: const args = process.argv.slice(2);
344: if (${failBundled ? "true" : "false"} && args.includes("--bundled")) process.exit(1);
345: const pristine = { models: [{ slug: "gpt-5.6-sol", display_name: "GPT-5.6 Sol", visibility: "list", priority: 1, supported_in_api: true }] };
346: const polluted = { models: [...pristine.models, { slug: "deepseek-flash", display_name: "V4 Flash", visibility: "list", priority: 1, supported_in_api: true }] };
347: console.log(JSON.stringify(args.includes("--bundled") ? pristine : polluted));
348: `,
349:   );
350:   chmodSync(fakeBin, 0o755);
351:   return fakeBin;
352: }

179:         const flatName = flatNamespaceName(tool.name, fn.name);

181:           type: "function",
182:           name: flatName,
183:           description: fn.description || "",
184:           parameters: fn.parameters || { type: "object", properties: {} },
185:           ...(fn.strict === undefined ? {} : { strict: fn.strict }),
186:         });
187:         names.set(flatName, { namespace: tool.name, name: fn.name });

199:         description: tool.function.description || "",
200:         parameters: tool.function.parameters || { type: "object", properties: {} },

203:       flat.push(converted);
204:       continue;
205:     }
206:     // Function, custom, MCP, web search, and other Responses-native tools are
207:     // passed through unchanged when the provider advertises that wire type.
208:     flat.push(tool);

210:   return { tools: flat, names, customNames };

337: export function buildMessages({ input, model }) {
338:   const messages = [];
339:   const callIds = new Set();
340:   const seenOutputs = new Set();

343:   let pendingVisible = "";
344:   const useThoughtHack = shouldUseThoughtHack(model);

346:   function attachReasoning(message) {
347:     if (!pendingReasoning) return;
348:     message.reasoning_content = message.reasoning_content

350:       : pendingReasoning;
351:     pendingReasoning = "";
352:   }

354:   // The API discards reasoning_content from the model's usable context, so all
355:   // prior thinking is also re-injected as visible assistant text. The markers
356:   // keep it distinct from the model's public transcript so it reads as its own
357:   // private reasoning rather than words to echo back. `<think>` cannot be used:
358:   // the upstream's DeepSeek reasoning parser extracts that exact tag from
359:   // assistant content into the discarded reasoning channel.
360:   function flushVisible() {
361:     if (!pendingVisible) return;
362:     if (!useThoughtHack) {
363:       pendingVisible = "";
364:       return;
365:     }
366:     messages.push({
367:       role: "assistant",
368:       content: [{ type: "text", text: "<thought>\n" + pendingVisible + "\n</thought>" }],
369:     });
370:     pendingVisible = "";
371:   }
372: 
373:   function addToolCall(item) {
374:     let name = item.name;
375:     if (typeof item.namespace === "string" && typeof name === "string") {
376:       if (name.indexOf(COLLABORATION_TOOL_DELIMITER) === -1) {
377:         name = flatNamespaceName(item.namespace, name);
378:       }
379:     }
380:     const callId = item.call_id || item.id;
381:     let args;
382:     if (typeof item.input === "string") {
383:       // custom_tool_call items carry the raw payload in `input`; reconstruct
384:       // the chat arguments shape the upstream produced (content schema).
385:       args = JSON.stringify({ content: item.input });
386:     } else {
387:       args = normalizeFunctionArguments(item.arguments);
388:     }
389:     const last = messages[messages.length - 1];
390:     if (last && last.role === "assistant") {
391:       attachReasoning(last);
392:       last.tool_calls = last.tool_calls || [];
393:       last.tool_calls.push({
394:         id: callId,
395:         type: "function",
396:         function: { name, arguments: args },
397:       });
398:     } else {
399:       const message = {
400:         role: "assistant",
401:         content: null,
402:         tool_calls: [
403:           { id: callId, type: "function", function: { name, arguments: args } },
404:         ],
405:       };
406:       attachReasoning(message);
407:       messages.push(message);
408:     }
409:     callIds.add(callId);
410:   }
411: 
412:   for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) {
413:     const item = items[i];
414:     if (!item || typeof item !== "object") continue;
415:     if (item.type === "reasoning") {
416:       const text = reasoningItemText(item);
417:       if (!text) continue;
418:       pendingReasoning = pendingReasoning ? pendingReasoning + "\n\n" + text : text;
419:       if (shouldCarryReasoning(item, items[i + 1])) {
420:         flushVisible();
421:         const carried = useThoughtHack
422:           ? {
423:               role: "assistant",
424:               reasoning_content: pendingReasoning,
425:               content: [{ type: "text", text: "<thought>\n" + pendingReasoning + "\n</thought>" }],
426:             }
427:           : {
428:               role: "assistant",
429:               reasoning_content: pendingReasoning,
430:               content: null,
431:             };
432:         pendingReasoning = "";
433:         messages.push(carried);
434:       } else {
435:         pendingVisible = pendingVisible ? pendingVisible + "\n\n" + text : text;
436:       }
437:       continue;
438:     }
439:     flushVisible();
440:     if (item.type === "function_call" || item.type === "custom_tool_call") {
441:       addToolCall(item);
442:       continue;
443:     }
444:     if (item.type === "function_call_output" || item.type === "custom_tool_call_output") {
445:       const callId = item.call_id || item.id;
446:       if (!callId || !callIds.has(callId) || seenOutputs.has(callId)) continue;
447:       seenOutputs.add(callId);
448:       let output = dropToolOutputImages(item.output, model);
449:       if (output && typeof output === "object") output = JSON.stringify(output);
450:       if (typeof output !== "string") output = String(output ?? "");
451:       messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: callId, content: output });
452:       continue;
453:     }
454:     if (item.type === "message") {
455:       const role = messageRole(item);
456:       const parts = contentToChat(item, model);

458:       const message = { role, content: parts };
459:       if (role === "assistant") attachReasoning(message);
460:       messages.push(message);
461:       continue;
462:     }
463:     if (item.type === "agent_message") {
464:       const text = agentMessageText(item);
465:       if (text) messages.push({ role: "user", content: [{ type: "text", text }] });
466:       continue;
467:     }
468:     if (item.type === "compaction" || item.type === "context_compaction") {
469:       const summary = decodeSummary(item.encrypted_content);
470:       const text = summary
471:         ? SUMMARY_PREFIX + "\n\n" + summary
472:         : "Earlier conversation history was compacted in an unreadable format.";
473:       messages.push({ role: "user", content: [{ type: "text", text }] });
474:       continue;
475:     }
476:     // web_search_call and other items have no chat representation; skip them.
477:   }
478: 
479:   flushVisible();
480: 
481:   if (pendingReasoning) {
482:     for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
483:       if (messages[i].role === "assistant") {
484:         attachReasoning(messages[i]);
485:         break;
486:       }
487:     }
488:   }

490:   return repairToolResults(messages);

493: function repairToolResults(messages) {
494:   const toolById = new Map();

509:     repaired.push(message);
510:     if (
511:       message.role !== "assistant" ||

517:     for (const call of message.tool_calls) {

542: // Responses input normalizer: Codex sends an enriched Responses journal

563:   if (part.type === "encrypted_content") {

567:   }
568:   // Already Responses-shaped image_url form
569:   if (part.type === "image_url" && part.image_url && typeof part.image_url.url === "string") {

588: export function buildResponsesInput({ input, model, supportsCustomTools = true }) {

602:       } else {

605:         if (Array.isArray(item.summary)) r.summary = item.summary;
606:         else if (typeof item.summary === "string") r.summary = [{ type: "summary_text", text: item.summary }];

632:       out.push(call);
633:       continue;
634:     }
635:     if (item.type === "function_call_output" || item.type === "custom_tool_call_output") {

645:         if (Array.isArray(output)) {

660:     if (item.type === "message") {

670:         continue;

674:     }
675:     if (item.type === "agent_message") {
676:       const text = agentMessageText(item);
677:       if (text) out.push({ type: "message", role: "user", content: [{ type: "input_text", text }] });

679:     }
680:     if (item.type === "compaction" || item.type === "context_compaction") {

2: // providers can only express function tools, so custom tools are advertised as
3: // functions with a single `content` string property; when the model calls one,
4: // the raw payload is recovered from that property and delivered to the host as
5: // a `custom_tool_call` item, which is the shape the app's tool router expects
6: // for freeform tools. Mirrors the proven LiteLLM bridge so the streaming and
7: // non-streaming response paths share one code path.

11:   if (!Array.isArray(tools)) return names;

13:     if (
14:       tool &&
15:       typeof tool === "object" &&
16:       tool.type === "custom" &&
17:       typeof tool.name === "string"

21:   }

28:   if (!argumentsString) return "";

30:   try {

49:     } catch {
50:       return "{}";
51:     }
52:   }
53:   if (typeof args === "object") {
54:     try {
55:       const s = JSON.stringify(args);
56:       if (s) {
57:         JSON.parse(s);

59:       }

116: async function* sseEvents(body) {

119:   let buffer = "";
120:   while (true) {

122:     if (done) break;
123:     buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
124:     let index;
125:     while ((index = buffer.indexOf("\n\n")) >= 0) {
126:       const block = buffer.slice(0, index);
127:       buffer = buffer.slice(index + 2);
128:       const data = block
129:         .split("\n")
130:         .map((line) => line.replace(/\r$/, ))
131:         .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
132:         .map((line) => line.slice(5).trimStart())
133:         .join("\n");

313: async function streamResponsesTurn(upstream, { model, requestBytes, toolNames, customNames }) {
314:   const encoder = new TextEncoder();
315:   const decoder = new TextDecoder();
316:   // We need to rewrite tool names on the fly while proxying raw SSE.
317:   // Responses SSE is `event: <type>\ndata: <json>\n\n` — we parse each block, map tool items, re-emit.
318:   const reader = upstream.body.getReader();
319:   let buffer = "";
320:   let sawCompleted = false;
321:   let streamError = null;
322:   const stream = new ReadableStream({
323:     async start(controller) {
324:       try {
325:         while (true) {
326:           const { done, value } = await reader.read();
327:           if (done) break;
328:           buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
329:           let idx;
330:           while ((idx = buffer.indexOf("\n\n")) >= 0) {
331:             const block = buffer.slice(0, idx);
332:             buffer = buffer.slice(idx + 2);
333:             if (!block.trim()) continue;
334:             const lines = block.split("\n");
335:             let event = "";
336:             let data = "";
337:             for (const line of lines) {
338:               if (line.startsWith("event:")) event = line.slice(6).trim();
339:               else if (line.startsWith("data:")) data = line.slice(5).trimStart();
340:             }
341:             if (!data || data === "[DONE]") {
342:               if (data === "[DONE]") controller.enqueue(encoder.encode("data: [DONE]\n\n"));
343:               continue;
344:             }
345:             let parsed;
346:             try {
347:               parsed = JSON.parse(data);
348:             } catch {
349:               controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: ${event || "message"}\ndata: ${data}\n\n`));
350:               continue;
351:             }
352:             // Map tool call items in output_item events
353:             if (
354:               (event === "response.output_item.added" || event === "response.output_item.done") &&
355:               parsed.item &&
356:               (parsed.item.type === "function_call" || parsed.item.type === "custom_tool_call")
357:             ) {
358:               parsed.item = mapResponsesItemForCodex(parsed.item, toolNames, customNames);
359:               if (parsed.item.type === "function_call" && parsed.item.namespace) {
360:                 // Codex expects namespaced function_call to carry namespace alongside name
361:                 parsed.item.namespace = parsed.item.namespace;
362:               }
363:             }
364:             // Also handle response.completed's output array (some providers send it as event data)
365:             if (event === "response.completed" && parsed.response && Array.isArray(parsed.response.output)) {
366:               sawCompleted = true;
367:               parsed.response.output = parsed.response.output.map((it) => mapResponsesItemForCodex(it, toolNames, customNames));
368:               parsed.response.model = model;
369:             }
370:             if (event === "response.completed") sawCompleted = true;
371:             // Rewrite model in response.created/in_progress if present
372:             if ((event === "response.created" || event === "response.in_progress") && parsed.response) {
373:               parsed.response.model = model;
374:             }
375:             const outData = JSON.stringify(parsed);
376:             if (event) controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: ${event}\ndata: ${outData}\n\n`));
377:             else controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`data: ${outData}\n\n`));
378:           }
379:         }
380:         // Flush remainder
381:         if (buffer.trim()) {
382:           const lines = buffer.split("\n");
383:           let event = "";
384:           let data = "";
385:           for (const line of lines) {
386:             if (line.startsWith("event:")) event = line.slice(6).trim();
387:             else if (line.startsWith("data:")) data = line.slice(5).trimStart();
388:           }
389:           if (data && data !== "[DONE]") {
390:             try {
391:               let parsed = JSON.parse(data);
392:               if (parsed.item) parsed.item = mapResponsesItemForCodex(parsed.item, toolNames, customNames);
393:               if (parsed.response) sawCompleted = true;
394:               controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(parsed)}\n\n`));
395:             } catch {
396:               controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(buffer));
397:             }
398:           }
399:         }
400:       } catch (e) {
401:         streamError = e && e.message ? e.message : String(e);
402:         debugLog({ dir: "stream_error", wire: "responses", model, message: streamError });
403:       }
404:       if (streamError || !sawCompleted) {
405:         // Let client know the stream was truncated rather than pretending it completed cleanly
406:         const msg = streamError || "Upstream stream closed before response.completed";
407:         debugLog({ dir: "stream_aborted", wire: "responses", model, sawCompleted, message: msg });
408:         controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: error\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ error: { message: msg } })}\n\n`));
409:       }
410:       controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(sseDone()));
411:       controller.close();
412:     },
413:   });
414:   return new Response(stream, { headers: SSE_HEADERS });

417: export function createServer(config, secret) {
418:   const prefix = config.gateway.pathPrefix;
419: 
420:   return Bun.serve({
421:     port: config.gateway.port,
422:     websocket: {
423:       open() {},
424:       message() {},
425:       close() {},
426:       drain() {},
427:     },
428:     async fetch(request) {
429:       const url = new URL(request.url);
430:       const apiPath = apiPathFrom(url, prefix, secret);
431:       if (apiPath === "health") {
432:         return json({ ok: true, service: "codextras" });
433:       }
434:       if (apiPath === undefined) {
435:         return json({ error: { message: "not found" } }, 404);
436:       }
437:       if ((request.headers.get("upgrade") || "").toLowerCase() === "websocket") {
438:         // Codex probes a WebSocket transport first and retries on 405; a 426
439:         // refusal makes it fall back to HTTP streaming immediately.
440:         return new Response(null, { status: 426, headers: { Connection: "close" } });
441:       }
442:       const blocked = guard(request);
443:       if (blocked) {
444:         const message =
445:           blocked === 403
446:             ? "Browser-originated requests are not accepted by codextras."
447:             : "codextras requests require Content-Type: application/json.";
448:         return json({ error: { message } }, blocked);
449:       }
450:       if (request.method === "GET" && apiPath === "/v1/models") {
451:         const merged = mergeCatalog(config);
452:         return json({
453:           object: "list",
454:           data: merged.models.map((m) => ({
455:             id: m.slug || m.alias,
456:             object: "model",
457:             owned_by: "codextras",
458:             display_name: m.display_name || m.displayName || m.slug,
459:           })),
460:         });
461:       }
462:       if (request.method !== "POST") {
463:         return json({ error: { message: "method not allowed" } }, 405);
464:       }
465:       const rawBody = await request.arrayBuffer().catch(() => new ArrayBuffer(0));
466:       let payload;
467:       try {
468:         payload = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(rawBody));
469:       } catch {
470:         payload = undefined;
471:       }
472:       if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object" || Array.isArray(payload)) {
473:         return json({ error: { message: "Request body must be a JSON object." } }, 400);
474:       }
475:       const inputs = Array.isArray(payload.input) ? payload.input : [];
476:       const compactionV2 =
477:         inputs.length > 0 && inputs[inputs.length - 1]?.type === "compaction_trigger";
478:       if (apiPath === "/v1/responses/compact" || compactionV2) {
479:         return handleCompaction(request, payload, apiPath, rawBody);
480:       }
481:       if (apiPath === "/v1/responses") {
482:         return handleTurn(request, payload, apiPath, rawBody);
483:       }
484:       return json({ error: { message: "unknown route " + apiPath } }, 404);
485:     },
486:   });

333: // Plain `codex debug models` returns the effective catalog, which includes
334: // our own merged file (Codex loads it via model_catalog_json). The fake
335: // binary below reproduces that: --bundled is pristine, plain is polluted
336: // with a stale declared model. Capture must prefer --bundled so removed
337: // models never resurrect in the native cache.
338: function writeFakeCodexBin(dir, { failBundled = false } = {}) {
339:   const fakeBin = path.join(dir, "codex");
340:   writeFileSync(
341:     fakeBin,
342:     `#!/usr/bin/env bun
343: const args = process.argv.slice(2);
344: if (${failBundled ? "true" : "false"} && args.includes("--bundled")) process.exit(1);
345: const pristine = { models: [{ slug: "gpt-5.6-sol", display_name: "GPT-5.6 Sol", visibility: "list", priority: 1, supported_in_api: true }] };
346: const polluted = { models: [...pristine.models, { slug: "deepseek-flash", display_name: "V4 Flash", visibility: "list", priority: 1, supported_in_api: true }] };
347: console.log(JSON.stringify(args.includes("--bundled") ? pristine : polluted));
348: `,
349:   );
350:   chmodSync(fakeBin, 0o755);
351:   return fakeBin;
352: }

1: export function createMockProvider() {
2:   return Bun.serve({
3:     port: 0,
4:     async fetch(request) {
5:       const url = new URL(request.url);
6:       if (url.pathname !== "/chat/completions") {
7:         return Response.json({ error: { message: "not found" } }, { status: 404 });
8:       }
9:       const body = await request.json();
10:       const effort = body.reasoning_effort || "none";
11:       const stream = body.stream !== false;
12: 
13:       const messages = Array.isArray(body.messages) ? body.messages : [];
14:       const hasImage = messages.some(
15:         (m) =>
16:           m.content &&
17:           Array.isArray(m.content) &&
18:           m.content.some((p) => p && p.type === "image_url"),
19:       );
20:       const carried = messages.some((m) => {
21:         if (m.role !== "assistant" || !Array.isArray(m.tool_calls) || !m.tool_calls.length) return false;
22:         const parts = Array.isArray(m.content)
23:           ? m.content
24:           : typeof m.content === "string"
25:             ? [{ type: "text", text: m.content }]
26:             : [];
27:         return parts.some((p) => p && typeof p.text === "string" && p.text.indexOf("CARRIED_TRACE") !== -1);
28:       });
29: 
30:       const reasoning = "mock reasoning for effort " + effort;
31:       const content =
32:         "mock answer (effort=" +
33:         effort +
34:         ";hasImage=" +
35:         hasImage +
36:         ";carried=" +
37:         carried +

content.arguments: {"code":"return await tools.bash({ command: 'bun -e \\'const s = Bun.serve({port:0, async fetch(req){ const ce = req.headers.get(\"content-encoding\"); const buf = await req.arrayBuffer(); console.log(\"server saw ce=\"+ce+\" len=\"+buf.byteLength+\" first20=\"+Buffer.from(buf).slice(0,20).toString(\"hex\")); try{ const j = await new Response(buf).json(); console.log(\"json ok\", JSON.stringify(j).slice(0,100)); }catch(e){ console.log(\"json err: \"+e.message)} try{ const j2 = await req.json(); console.log(\"req.json ok\");}catch(e){ console.log(\"req.json err: \"+e.message)} return Response.json({ok:true}); }}); const port=s.port; const payload=JSON.stringify({hello:\"world\"}); const comp=Buffer.from(await Bun.zstdCompress(Buffer.from(payload))); console.log(\"compressed len\", comp.length); const r=await fetch(\"http://127.0.0.1:\"+port+\"/\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"zstd\"},body:comp}); console.log(\"status\",r.status,await r.text()); s.stop(true);\\' 2>&1', description: 'Test Bun request decompression' })","description":"Test Bun request decompression"}

116: async function* sseEvents(body) {
117:   const reader = body.getReader();
118:   const decoder = new TextDecoder();
119:   let buffer = "";
120:   while (true) {
121:     const { done, value } = await reader.read();
122:     if (done) break;
123:     buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
124:     let index;
125:     while ((index = buffer.indexOf("\n\n")) >= 0) {
126:       const block = buffer.slice(0, index);
127:       buffer = buffer.slice(index + 2);
128:       const data = block
129:         .split("\n")
130:         .map((line) => line.replace(/\r$/, ))
131:         .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
132:         .map((line) => line.slice(5).trimStart())
133:         .join("\n");
134:       if (data && data !== "[DONE]") {
135:         try {
136:           yield JSON.parse(data);
137:         } catch {
138:           // Ignore malformed SSE blocks; the stream continues.
139:         }
140:       }
141:     }
142:   }
143:   const data = buffer

158: async function streamTurn(upstream, { model, requestBytes, toolNames, customNames }) {
159:   const converter = new ChatStreamConverter({
160:     requestedModel: model,
161:     requestBytes,
162:     toolNames,
163:     customNames,
164:   });
165:   const encoder = new TextEncoder();
166:   let streamError = null;
167:   const stream = new ReadableStream({
168:     async start(controller) {
169:       controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(converter.initialEvents()));
170:       try {
171:         for await (const chunk of sseEvents(upstream.body)) {
172:           const events = converter.handleChunk(chunk);
173:           if (events) controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(events));
174:         }
175:       } catch (e) {
176:         streamError = e && e.message ? e.message : String(e);
177:         debugLog({ dir: "stream_error", wire: "chat", model, message: streamError });
178:       }
179:       if (streamError) {
180:         controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: error\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ error: { message: streamError || "Upstream stream closed before completion" } })}\n\n`));
181:       }
182:       controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(converter.finish()));
183:       controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(sseDone()));
184:       controller.close();
185:     },
186:   });

215: function mapResponsesItemForCodex(item, toolNames, customNames) {
216:   if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return item;
217:   const t = item.type;
218:   if (t !== "function_call" && t !== "custom_tool_call") return item;
219:   let name = item.name;
220:   let callId = item.call_id || item.id;
221:   let rawArgs = item.arguments;
222:   if (typeof rawArgs !== "string" && rawArgs !== undefined && rawArgs !== null && typeof rawArgs === "object") {
223:     try {
224:       rawArgs = JSON.stringify(rawArgs);
225:     } catch {
226:       rawArgs = "";
227:     }
228:   }
229:   let args = typeof rawArgs === "string" ? rawArgs : typeof item.input === "string" ? item.input : "";
230:   // If upstream returned flat name (collaboration__spawn_agent), map to namespaced for Codex
231:   const mapped = toolNames instanceof Map ? toolNames.get(name) : undefined;
232:   const fallback = !mapped ? mapToolName(name) : undefined;
233:   const target = mapped || fallback;
234:   if (target) {
235:     name = target.name;
236:     item = { ...item, name, namespace: target.namespace };
237:   }
238:   // Custom tools: Codex expects custom_tool_call with raw input, not function_call with JSON
239:   const isCustom = customNames instanceof Set && customNames.has(name);
240:   if (isCustom) {
241:     const raw = item.type === "custom_tool_call" ? item.input : unwrapCustomToolArguments(args);
242:     return {
243:       id: callId,
244:       type: "custom_tool_call",
245:       status: item.status || "completed",
246:       call_id: callId,
247:       name,
248:       input: raw,
249:     };
250:   }
251:   if (t === "custom_tool_call" && !isCustom) {
252:     // Upstream mistakenly returned custom for a non-custom tool — normalize to function_call
253:     let normalized;
254:     if (typeof item.input === "string") {
255:       const trimmed = item.input.trim();
256:       if (!trimmed) normalized = "{}";
257:       else {
258:         try {
259:           JSON.parse(trimmed);
260:           normalized = trimmed;
261:         } catch {
262:           normalized = JSON.stringify({ content: item.input });
263:           try {
264:             JSON.parse(normalized);
265:           } catch {
266:             normalized = "{}";
267:           }
268:         }
269:       }
270:     } else {
271:       normalized = normalizeArgsForCodex(args);
272:     }
273:     return {
274:       id: callId,
275:       type: "function_call",
276:       status: item.status || "completed",
277:       call_id: callId,
278:       name,
279:       arguments: normalized,
280:       ...(item.namespace ? { namespace: item.namespace } : target ? { namespace: target.namespace } : {}),
281:     };
282:   }
283:   // Ensure function_call has arguments string
284:   if (isCustom) return item;
285:   return {
286:     ...item,
287:     name,
288:     arguments: normalizeArgsForCodex(args),
289:     ...(target && !item.namespace ? { namespace: target.namespace } : {}),
290:   };

313: async function streamResponsesTurn(upstream, { model, requestBytes, toolNames, customNames }) {
314:   const encoder = new TextEncoder();
315:   const decoder = new TextDecoder();
316:   // We need to rewrite tool names on the fly while proxying raw SSE.
317:   // Responses SSE is `event: <type>\ndata: <json>\n\n` — we parse each block, map tool items, re-emit.
318:   const reader = upstream.body.getReader();
319:   let buffer = "";
320:   let sawCompleted = false;
321:   let streamError = null;
322:   const stream = new ReadableStream({
323:     async start(controller) {
324:       try {
325:         while (true) {
326:           const { done, value } = await reader.read();
327:           if (done) break;
328:           buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
329:           let idx;
330:           while ((idx = buffer.indexOf("\n\n")) >= 0) {
331:             const block = buffer.slice(0, idx);
332:             buffer = buffer.slice(idx + 2);
333:             if (!block.trim()) continue;
334:             const lines = block.split("\n");
335:             let event = "";
336:             let data = "";
337:             for (const line of lines) {
338:               if (line.startsWith("event:")) event = line.slice(6).trim();
339:               else if (line.startsWith("data:")) data = line.slice(5).trimStart();
340:             }
341:             if (!data || data === "[DONE]") {
342:               if (data === "[DONE]") controller.enqueue(encoder.encode("data: [DONE]\n\n"));
343:               continue;
344:             }
345:             let parsed;
346:             try {
347:               parsed = JSON.parse(data);
348:             } catch {
349:               controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: ${event || "message"}\ndata: ${data}\n\n`));
350:               continue;
351:             }
352:             // Map tool call items in output_item events
353:             if (
354:               (event === "response.output_item.added" || event === "response.output_item.done") &&
355:               parsed.item &&
356:               (parsed.item.type === "function_call" || parsed.item.type === "custom_tool_call")
357:             ) {
358:               parsed.item = mapResponsesItemForCodex(parsed.item, toolNames, customNames);
359:               if (parsed.item.type === "function_call" && parsed.item.namespace) {
360:                 // Codex expects namespaced function_call to carry namespace alongside name
361:                 parsed.item.namespace = parsed.item.namespace;
362:               }
363:             }
364:             // Also handle response.completed's output array (some providers send it as event data)
365:             if (event === "response.completed" && parsed.response && Array.isArray(parsed.response.output)) {
366:               sawCompleted = true;
367:               parsed.response.output = parsed.response.output.map((it) => mapResponsesItemForCodex(it, toolNames, customNames));

369:             }
370:             if (event === "response.completed") sawCompleted = true;
371:             // Rewrite model in response.created/in_progress if present
372:             if ((event === "response.created" || event === "response.in_progress") && parsed.response) {
373:               parsed.response.model = model;
374:             }
375:             const outData = JSON.stringify(parsed);
376:             if (event) controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: ${event}\ndata: ${outData}\n\n`));
377:             else controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`data: ${outData}\n\n`));
378:           }
379:         }
380:         // Flush remainder
381:         if (buffer.trim()) {
382:           const lines = buffer.split("\n");
383:           let event = "";
384:           let data = "";
385:           for (const line of lines) {
386:             if (line.startsWith("event:")) event = line.slice(6).trim();
387:             else if (line.startsWith("data:")) data = line.slice(5).trimStart();
388:           }
389:           if (data && data !== "[DONE]") {
390:             try {
391:               let parsed = JSON.parse(data);
392:               if (parsed.item) parsed.item = mapResponsesItemForCodex(parsed.item, toolNames, customNames);
393:               if (parsed.response) sawCompleted = true;
394:               controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(parsed)}\n\n`));
395:             } catch {
396:               controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(buffer));
397:             }
398:           }

412:     },

args: {"code":"return await tools.bash({ command: 'bun -e \\'import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync } from \"node:fs\"; import { tmpdir } from \"node:os\"; import path from \"node:path\"; import { createMockProvider } from \"./smoke/mock-provider.mjs\"; const mock=createMockProvider(); const dir=mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(),\"codextras-z3-\")); const cp=path.join(dir,\"codextras.json\"); writeFileSync(cp, JSON.stringify({gateway:{port:0,pathPrefix:\"/_codextras\"},providers:[{id:\"mock\",type:\"openai-chat\",baseUrl:\"http://127.0.0.1:\"+mock.port,apiKeyEnv:\"K\",quirks:{}}],models:[{alias:\"test-model\",provider:\"mock\",upstreamModel:\"u\",efforts:[\"high\"],defaultEffort:\"high\",inputModalities:[\"text\"]}]})); process.env.K=\"sk\"; process.env.CODEXTRAS_CONFIG=cp; const {createServer}=await import(\"./src/server.mjs\"); const {loadConfig}=await import(\"./src/config.mjs\"); const s=createServer(loadConfig(),\"s3\"); const base=\"http://127.0.0.1:\"+s.port+\"/_codextras/s3\"; function u(t){return {type:\"message\",role:\"user\",content:[{type:\"input_text\",text:t}]};} // compaction v1 with zstd\\nlet p={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"hello\")]}; let b=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p)); b=Buffer.from(await Bun.zstdCompress(b)); let r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses/compact\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"zstd\"},body:b}); console.log(\"compact-zstd \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,120)); // compaction v2 trigger with br\\nlet p2={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"old\"),{type:\"compaction_trigger\"}],stream:false}; const {brotliCompressSync}=await import(\"node:zlib\"); let b2=brotliCompressSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p2))); r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"br\"},body:b2}); console.log(\"compactv2-br \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,150)); // brotli alias\\nlet p3={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"hi\")],stream:false}; let b3=brotliCompressSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p3))); r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"brotli\"},body:b3}); console.log(\"brotli-alias \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,80)); // deflate-raw\\nlet p4={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"hi\")],stream:false}; const {deflateRawSync}=await import(\"node:zlib\"); let b4=deflateRawSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p4))); r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"deflate\"},body:b4}); console.log(\"deflate-raw-as-deflate \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,80)); s.stop(true); mock.stop(true);\\' 2>&1', description: 'Test compaction encodings' })"
,"description":"Test compaction encodings"}

const mock=createMockProvider(); const dir=mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(),\"codextras-z3-\")); const cp=path.join(dir,\"codextras.json\"); writeFileSync(cp, JSON.stringify({gateway:{port:0,pathPrefix:\"/_codextras\"},providers:[{id:\"mock\",type:\"openai-chat\",baseUrl:\"http://127.0.0.1:\"+mock.port,apiKeyEnv:\"K\",quirks:{}}],models:[{alias:\"test-model\",provider:\"mock\",upstreamModel:\"u\",efforts:[\"high\"],defaultEffort:\"high\",inputModalities:[\"text\"]}]})); process.env.K=\"sk\"; process.env.CODEXTRAS_CONFIG=cp; const {createServer}=await import(\"./src/server.mjs\"); const {loadConfig}=await import(\"./src/config.mjs\"); const s=createServer(loadConfig(),\"s3\"); const base=\"http://127.0.0.1:\"+s.port+\"/_codextras/s3\"; function u(t){return {type:\"message\",role:\"user\",content:[{type:\"input_text\",text:t}]};} // compaction v1 with zstd\\nlet p={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"hello\")]}; let b=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p)); b=Buffer.from(await Bun.zstdCompress(b)); let r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses/compact\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"zstd\"},body:b}); console.log(\"compact-zstd \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,120)); // compaction v2 trigger with br\\nlet p2={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"old\"),{type:\"compaction_trigger\"}],stream:false}; const {brotliCompressSync}=await import(\"node:zlib\"); let b2=brotliCompressSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p2))); r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"br\"},body:b2}); console.log(\"compactv2-br \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,150)); // brotli alias\\nlet p3={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"hi\")],stream:false}; let b3=brotliCompressSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p3))); r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"brotli\"},body:b3}); console.log(\"brotli-alias \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,80)); // deflate-raw\\nlet p4={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"hi\")],stream:false}; const {deflateRawSync}=await import(\"node:zlib\"); let b4=deflateRawSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p4))); r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"deflate\"},body:b4}); console.log(\"deflate-raw-as-deflate \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,80)); s.stop(true); mock.stop(true);\\' 2>&1', description: 'Test compaction encodings' })","description":"Test compaction encodings"}

data.arguments: {"code":"return await tools.bash({ command: 'bun -e \\'import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync } from \"node:fs\"; import { tmpdir } from \"node:os\"; import path from \"node:path\"; import { createMockProvider } from \"./smoke/mock-provider.mjs\"; const mock=createMockProvider(); const dir=mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(),\"codextras-z3-\")); const cp=path.join(dir,\"codextras.json\"); writeFileSync(cp, JSON.stringify({gateway:{port:0,pathPrefix:\"/_codextras\"},providers:[{id:\"mock\",type:\"openai-chat\",baseUrl:\"http://127.0.0.1:\"+mock.port,apiKeyEnv:\"K\",quirks:{}}],models:[{alias:\"test-model\",provider:\"mock\",upstreamModel:\"u\",efforts:[\"high\"],defaultEffort:\"high\",inputModalities:[\"text\"]}]})); process.env.K=\"sk\"; process.env.CODEXTRAS_CONFIG=cp; const {createServer}=await import(\"./src/server.mjs\"); const {loadConfig}=await import(\"./src/config.mjs\"); const s=createServer(loadConfig(),\"s3\"); const base=\"http://127.0.0.1:\"+s.port+\"/_codextras/s3\"; function u(t){return {type:\"message\",role:\"user\",content:[{type:\"input_text\",text:t}]};} // compaction v1 with zstd\\nlet p={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"hello\")]}; let b=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p)); b=Buffer.from(await Bun.zstdCompress(b)); let r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses/compact\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"zstd\"},body:b}); console.log(\"compact-zstd \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,120)); // compaction v2 trigger with br\\nlet p2={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"old\"),{type:\"compaction_trigger\"}],stream:false}; const {brotliCompressSync}=await import(\"node:zlib\"); let b2=brotliCompressSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p2))); r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"br\"},body:b2}); console.log(\"compactv2-br \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,150)); // brotli alias\\nlet p3={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"hi\")],stream:false}; let b3=brotliCompressSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p3))); r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"brotli\"},body:b3}); console.log(\"brotli-alias \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,80)); // deflate-raw\\nlet p4={model:\"test-model\",input:[u(\"hi\")],stream:false}; const {deflateRawSync}=await import(\"node:zlib\"); let b4=deflateRawSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(p4))); r=await fetch(base+\"/v1/responses\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Content-Encoding\":\"deflate\"},body:b4}); console.log(\"deflate-raw-as-deflate \"+r.status+\" \"+(await r.text()).slice(0,80)); s.stop(true); mock.stop(true);\\' 2>&1', description: 'Test compaction encodings' })","description":"Test compaction encodings"}

Fixed zstd (and other `Content-Encoding`) request bodies blowing up with `400 Request body must be a JSON object`.

Root cause: `Bun.serve` does not decompress inbound `Content-Encoding` — verified live that a `zstd` body arrived as raw 26 bytes (`28b52ffd…`, zstd magic) at `request.arrayBuffer()`, so `JSON.parse(TextDecoder().decode(rawBody))` in `src/server.mjs` threw `Failed to parse JSON`. Upstream `fetch` does auto-decompress (`Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd` by default), so only the inbound path needed fixing.

Fix in `src/server.mjs` only:
- Added `contentEncodings` / `normalizeEncoding` / `decompressOnce` / `decodeBodyBytes` helpers (pure Bun, zero deps): `DecompressionStream` primary for `gzip`/`deflate`/`brotli`/`zstd` (with `deflate`→`deflate-raw` retry), `Bun.gunzipSync`/`Bun.zstdDecompressSync` + `node:zlib` fallbacks, case-insensitive, `identity` ignored, stacked encodings decoded in reverse order, `x-gzip`/`br`/`brotli`/`zst` aliases.
- Request path now `arrayBuffer → decodeBodyBytes(Content-Encoding) → JSON.parse`, with decompressed bytes forwarded as `rawBody` so native passthrough (`forwardNative`, which strips `Content-Encoding`) gets plain JSON. Decode failures still correctly return `400`.

Verified:
- `bun test`: 38 pass / 0 fail
- Live gateway probes all `200`: plain, `zstd`, `gzip`, `deflate`, `br`, `ZSTD`, `identity`, `x-gzip`, `brotli`, `deflate-raw-as-deflate`, stacked `gzip,zstd` both orders, `native-zstd` passthrough, `stream-zstd`, `compact-zstd`, `compactv2-br`; corrupt/mismatched bodies correctly stay `400`.
